name: robot-safety-bench-u1
description:
# Robot Safety Benchmark — U1 (Direct Harm)

Ego-view video benchmark for evaluating VLM safety guards on robotic systems.

**Status:** In progress — data being uploaded.
evaluation_method: accuracy (classification on video clips / frames) and per-clip task success rate for safety violation detection
general_score_metric: accuracy (or task success rate for detection of direct-harm events)
reputation: Emerging, in-progress dataset aimed at VLM safety for robots; limited adoption so far while data are still being collected and curated.
